_comment: exp/nextgen-fin Grid B sweep 2. Same thin-through skeleton as designs_nextgen_nobiax_s2.json, but the MID pad (kick knob) and QUARTER/TIP pads use hexcel_himax_biax_100 (0.12 mm cured, half the twill ply) so the MID step -- and thus a MID kick -- can be bought for less flex. NOTE the biax card is a stand-in equal to twill_3k_198 in stiffness; the only real difference vs Grid A is ply thickness.
_targets: flex W(90) ~13.5 N (baseline 15.52 - 2), kick MID f~0.46, k_twist > 16249 N.mm/rad at a matched theta_at_probe (baseline 118.3 deg).
